# suggestions.v1 §6 / session.v3 §6 — every line `review` renders, byte for byte.
#
# Format: a `## <case>` line, then that case's exact output, until the next
# `## `. Comment lines start with `#` and only appear before the first case,
# so a `#` inside a receipt is still a receipt.
#
# The four `page_*` blocks are what the LIBRARY renders (`render_review_page`)
# from a REAL temp inbox of 17 / 8 / 0 items, appended through `inbox.append`:
# `tests/test_tool_memory.py` and `conformance/session/tool/run.py` each build
# that inbox for themselves and compare the bytes against these rows, so a page
# that only passes because a stand-in was fed pre-rendered text cannot pass here.
# The seeded text, quote, session and date are spelled identically in both
# places; this file is what keeps them identical.
#
# §6 as amended 2026-09-07 is the shape: a bold header with `— page P of Q` only
# when paged (8 items is one page, and has no suffix), each item a numbered bold
# id with its text, the quote WHOLE inside a blockquote with its session and date
# on the quote's own last line, a blank line between items, and a closing command
# line whose `next` appears only while there is a next page.
#
# The receipt rows below are the ratified work item's (amplifier_bundle_memory-862,
# 2026-09-06 23:00). The hint line's `…` stands where the command repeats, and is
# rendered literally: a fixture that "tidies" a contract's own bytes is how a
# surface drifts from the thing it is measured against.
